correctness.rationale: The exact external trace is P_i symmetric-difference Q_j. Equal traces exactly correspond to consecutive-position/consecutive-rank common intervals. Singleton and full-set collisions form a forest for nonmonotone permutations, with 2m+2 independent edges. Every proper nonmonotone interval or monotone bond produces an additional identification unless monotonicity is global; monotone global permutations are directly counted. Simple permutations have only baseline identifications. Prepending a shared minimum to a simple tail produces exactly m²−2 traces. Exhaustive tests through 8 and constructive tests through 30 corroborate analytic arguments.
